sources.content: The quorsel-dns image runs Quorsel, a caching DNS resolver for container clusters. It is built on alpine:3.20. Quorsel starts as root to bind port 53 on UDP and TCP, then drops to the user quorsel with user ID 953. Its config file is /etc/quorsel/quorsel.conf. The entrypoint is /usr/sbin/quorsel -f, which keeps the process in the foreground. Prometheus metrics are served on port 9153. The image is about 9 MB compressed.

Environment variables. QUORSEL_FORWARDERS lists upstream servers and defaults to 1.1.1.1,9.9.9.9. QUORSEL_CACHE_SIZE sets the number of cached records and defaults to 10000. QUORSEL_MIN_TTL forces a lower bound on cached TTLs in seconds and defaults to 0, which keeps the upstream TTL. Set QUORSEL_DNSSEC=on to validate DNSSEC signatures; it is off by default. The health check resolves localhost.quorsel every 30 seconds. Set QUORSEL_LOG_QUERIES=true to log every query; query logging is off by default.
